{{Top|leg}}
The '''Atrisian Assault Corps''' was the elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit serving under the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]] [[Emperor/Legends|emperors]] of the [[Atrisian Empire]]. It was a fast and hard-hitting unit capable of overcoming any enemy force it faced. The Assault Corps included [[His Majesty's Roto-gunners]], the [[Imperial Atrisian Grenadiers]], and the [[Queen's Own Armored Cavalry Troop]].
